description: All integers. Permille means parts per thousand. Palette colors are #RRGGBB.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Surface width in terminal cells.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Surface height in terminal cells.

fields.name: effect
fields.description: 0 solid; 1 linear; 2 diagonal; 3 wave; 4 rotation; 5 plasma.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: 0 material only; 1 prompt; 2 controls; 3 hue ribbon; 4 scope.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Coordinate-hashed star and grain seed.

fields.name: stars
fields.description: Enable the star foreground layer.

fields.name: densityPermille
fields.description: Probability per cell of containing a star, in thousandths.

fields.name: glyphSet
fields.description: 0 mixed; 1 braille; 2 punctuation; 3 mathematical; 4 custom.

fields.name: starPeriodMinMs
fields.description: Minimum individual twinkle cycle in milliseconds.

fields.name: starPeriodRangeMs
fields.description: Additional coordinate-hashed cycle range.

fields.name: starDutyPermille
fields.description: Active fraction of each individual twinkle cycle.

fields.name: starFloorPermille
fields.description: Minimum star intensity relative to its peak color.

fields.name: starPeakPermille
fields.description: Maximum star intensity relative to its peak color.

fields.name: gradientPeriodMs
fields.description: Time for one full material cycle, in milliseconds.

fields.name: saturationPermille
fields.description: Palette saturation, in thousandths.

fields.name: brightnessPermille
fields.description: Material contribution over the base color.

fields.name: focusRow
fields.description: Active row; -1 selects the middle row.

fields.name: neighborSpeedPermille
fields.description: Speed multiplier per row away from focus.

fields.name: neighborSaturationPermille
fields.description: Saturation multiplier per row away from focus.

fields.name: neighborBrightnessPermille
fields.description: Brightness multiplier per row away from focus.

fields.name: angleDegrees
fields.description: Static diagonal angle in degrees.

fields.name: scaleCells
fields.description: Spatial wavelength in terminal columns.

fields.name: hueStepDegrees
fields.description: Hue offset per character.

fields.name: hueDegreesPerSecond
fields.description: Signed rotation speed of character hues.

fields.name: baseHueDegrees
fields.description: Starting hue for character effects.

fields.name: pixelMode
fields.description: 0 whole cell; 1 upper half; 2 left half; 3 shade; 4 braille contour.

fields.name: originX
fields.description: World-space horizontal origin for stable resize and scrolling.

fields.name: originY
fields.description: World-space vertical origin for stable resize and scrolling.

fields.name: valuePermille
fields.description: Immediate demonstration data value; not interpolated.

fields.name: motion
fields.description: 0 renders the zero-time state; host pause instead preserves last motion time.

fields.name: phaseDegrees
fields.description: Initial material phase.

fields.name: grainPermille
fields.description: Subtle fixed spatial grain amplitude.

fields.name: cursorMode
fields.description: 0 block; 1 underline; 2 bar; 3 orbiting dots.

fields.name: borderStyle
fields.description: 0 rounded; 1 square; 2 double; 3 heavy.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Immediate selected demonstration menu index.

fields.name: foregroundColor
fields.description: Default text color as packed RGB.

fields.name: baseColor
fields.description: Dark Black Creme, packed RGB.

fields.name: waveAmplitudePermille
fields.description: Wave distortion strength.

fields.name: starAttackPermille
fields.description: Fraction of active twinkle spent brightening.

fields.name: paletteCount
fields.description: Number of active gradient colors.

fields.name: starPaletteCount
fields.description: Number of active star peak colors.

fields.name: glyphCount
fields.description: Number of custom star code points.

fields.name: modalOpen
fields.description: Show the demonstration modal.

fields.name: hueSaturationPermille
fields.description: Saturation of character hue-wheel effects.

fields.name: hueBrightnessPermille
fields.description: Brightness of character hue-wheel effects.

fields.name: cellAspectPermille
fields.description: Physical cell height / width, in thousandths.

fields.name: textScrimPermille
fields.description: Text-cell background blend toward the base color.

fields.name: promptBands
fields.description: Apply focused row falloff even without the prompt demonstration layout.

fields.name: colorMode
fields.description: 0 predefined palette; 1 full 360-degree hue wheel; 2 120-degree-offset RGB sine waves.
